title: Subspace decomposition with defect diffusion coefficient
summary: Elliptic diffusion problems with multiscale heterogeneous coefficients lead to poorly conditioned discrete systems and therefore require effective preconditioning strategies. While subspace decomposition preconditioners perform well for fixed realizations of the coefficient, their repeated construction becomes prohibitively expensive in uncertainty quantification settings, particularly in Monte-Carlo simulations, where a large number of fine-scale realizations must be treated.
